The '''Imperial Treasury''' was a governmental agency for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were headquartered on the [[City/Legends|city]]-[[Ecumenopolis/Legends|spanning]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Regent/Legends|Vice-Regent]] [[Accountant/Legends|Accountant]] [[Llohm Dunney]] worked at the Treasury. The [[Imperial Collection Agency]] was an arm of the Imperial Treasury responsible for collecting revenues through fines and taxes. The Imperial Treasury was known to collect a large percentage of profits that came from activities taking place on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]], a large [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Besh Gorgon system/Legends|Besh Gorgon system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. An [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] named [[Dagdan Dimnid]] acted as the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]]'s eyes and ears in the treasury.<ref name="University">{{GamerCite|4|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Advozsec}}</ref>
